TRAFFIC ADVISORY
PROJECTS COMMISSIONING IN THE FCT
DAY 6 - THURSDAY 19TH JUNE, 2025

Commissioning of the newly constructed collector road CN2 (Zakaria A. Kyari Street) from arterial road N11 (Ahmadu Bello Way) in Mabushi to Judges Quarters in Katampe and other roads.

Accordingly, there will be road blockage and diversion within and around the venue of the event especially along the Zakari A. Kyari street, Mabushi at the following points:

A) Near the intersection on Ahmadu Bello Way by Mabushi Bus
Terminal.

B) Access to the collector road near Gishiri village.

C) Mississippi junction on Arterial Road N16 (Shehu Shagari Way) and other connecting points along the route.

Activation time for diversion is 1200hr.
Traffic control personnel and security agents will be deployed to ensure seamless traffic flow away from the route.

- Head Traffic, DRTS
